summary: Powell Max Ltd filed a 6-K disclosing a September 25, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement with Blackrod Holdings, LLC (doing business as Remington Firearms) and its members. Powell Max issued Class A ordinary shares equal to 19.99% of pre-closing Class A shares outstanding, approximately 261,531 shares, in exchange for newly issued Blackrod units representing 1.5% of Blackrod equity. The parties intend to negotiate a definitive merger agreement at an estimated $200 million to $250 million enterprise value, though no merger agreement has been executed. Closing requires governmental consents, with 10% of shares escrowed 18 months for indemnification.
